browserJourneys.name: Desktop minimum business loop
steps: Launch the packaged app offline
Select a fictional DOCX fixture with the recommended readable mode
Finish OOXML, text, image, hidden-content and combination-risk detection
Review every text, visual and object item
Compare original and semantic-preserving output
Review the password-free local-custody warning
Generate the same-format analysis copy, local mapping table and report
Wait for independent output rescan
Open AI交付 and 本地保管 separately
expected: The source file is unchanged
Roles, relationships, sequence and quantity scale remain understandable
The same entity uses one replacement across text, tables and image OCR
No confirmed original value remains in the analysis copy or report
Only the local-custody mapping table contains reversible originals
The completion copy does not claim declassification or upload safety

browserJourneys.name: Excel semantic and structural loop
steps: Open a fictional XLSX with repeated entities, formulas, hidden sheets, comments, images and external links
Resolve all text, visual, hidden and object findings
Generate and rescan the XLSX analysis copy
expected: Visible grid, merged cells, basic styles and numeric types remain readable
Formulas and external links are absent
All output sheets, rows and columns are visible
The mapping rows reconcile with every transformed entity

browserJourneys.name: Fail-closed Office security workflow
steps: Open legacy, encrypted, macro-enabled, damaged, spoofed and unsafe OOXML fixtures
Inspect each blocking reason
Attempt to continue to export
expected: Each task enters Blocked
No override or export action is available
No source text or full path appears in logs

browserJourneys.name: Task return and mapping cleanup
steps: Complete a fictional task
Choose New task
Return to file selection
Inspect safe diagnostic state
expected: Prior text and plaintext mappings are unavailable in application state
The completed sensitive mapping table remains under 本地保管
The app remains fully functional without network

browserJourneys.name: Plain-language review with immediate feedback
steps: Open the 确认处理 step with several ordinary text findings
Choose 采用建议 on the current card
Observe the card, pending count and selection
expected: The current item visibly completes
The pending count decreases immediately
A short success message appears
The next pending item is selected
No forbidden internal strategy term is visible

browserJourneys.name: One-click ordinary review without security bypass
steps: Open a fictional mixed task with ordinary text, an image, combination risk and an embedded object
Choose 采用全部普通建议
expected: Ordinary and deterministic-rule text findings complete
The image and combination risk remain pending while removable hidden objects are already marked removed
Export remains blocked until excluded items are explicitly resolved

browserJourneys.name: Encrypted persistent fixed replacement and mandatory standard
steps: Add 公安 to GA and a mandatory 530网 to 5**网 standard
Close and restart the application
Scan a fictional DOCX or XLSX containing the terms
Attempt to keep an original mandatory match
expected: Both rules persist for the current Windows user
The same result is used across text, cells and OCR
Keeping a mandatory original is unavailable
The local-custody task mapping records the rule source
The rule library itself is absent from AI交付 and the HTML report

browserJourneys.name: Preserve dates and times verbatim
steps: Scan a fictional DOCX or XLSX containing dates and times
Open the review step
Inspect the final preview
expected: No time finding enters the review list
Dates and times remain unchanged in the final preview
Time findings do not create or contribute to combination risk

browserJourneys.name: Common structured personal-data masking
steps: Scan a fictional DOCX or XLSX containing common personal fields
Inspect the suggested replacements
Include one valid and one invalid unlabeled bank-card-shaped number
expected: Names, mobile numbers, ID cards, emails and landlines use the confirmed masks
Only the unlabeled number that passes Luhn validation is classified as a bank card
The bank card retains only the approved first six and last four digits
